segment_semantics: New simulator reset; retain parent actor, critics, targets, optimizers, temperature and real replay. Not an independent from-scratch training run or exact trajectory resume.
matched_control: Continue C from the identical parent checkpoint, seed and interaction budget with unchanged SAC/expert mixing and no planner/model additions
wm_sequence_sampling: Filter randomly drawn online H2 pairs by episode identity and time; draw an equal expert count, without resampling or crossing resets

smoke.purpose: Execution, accounting, freezing, replay and finite update checks; not a performance conclusion
